native_capture.native_path: FPDF_InitLibrary -> FPDF_CreateNewDocument -> FPDFPage_New -> FPDFPage_SetRotation/GetRotation -> FPDFPage_NewFormObj(counterrotation) -> native path create/line/close/fill -> FPDFFormObj_InsertObject/CountObjects/GenarateStream -> FPDFPage_InsertObject/GenerateContent -> FPDF_SaveAsCopy -> FPDF_FILEWRITE.WriteBlock

evidence_boundary: Executes pinned PDFium document/page/form/path/resource generation and PDF save, then parses the exact serialized PDF bytes. Host-supplied blank page dimensions, rotation, triangle points, color, and FILEWRITE callback are synthetic. It does not load a source PDF, exercise Samsung SPenPdfOpenWriter, prove source CropBox/Rotate/UserUnit placement, or establish Samsung/native pixel parity. Host hypotf uses hash-pinned Linux libm, not Android libm. The checked formatter handles only observed conversions. C-locale multibyte conversion and epoch-zero UTC time are deterministic host services; directory enumeration is represented as unavailable. Mutex/condition calls are single-thread no-ops, which provides no concurrency evidence. Host allocation and zlib are explicit providers. Every imported host symbol is recorded; an unhandled import aborts the replay.
